vendor_guide_features.L1: G, D, S and SS when applicable; temperature-dependent IV and voltage-dependent capacitance; no internal thermal network or package stray inductance.
vendor_guide_features.L3: L1 features plus package stray inductance and Cauer thermal network; includes Tc and Tj thermal terminals.
vendor_guide_features.thermal_units: Thermal-node voltage represents temperature in degrees Celsius; thermal resistance in degrees Celsius per watt.
vendor_guide_features.trapping: The guide does not claim a trapping or dynamic-Ron history model. Without the actual model file, its trap coverage cannot be verified.

cauer_data_from_datasheet.topology: Junction -> R1 -> node2 -> R2 -> node3 -> R3 -> node4 -> R4 -> case; C1 at junction and C2/C3/C4 at successive nodes, each capacitor to the thermal reference.

reproduction_use: Paper Figure 14 explicitly uses a constant 80 milliohm resistance and a thermal model. This source-grounded baseline can proceed without an electrical vendor SPICE model.
